scope: Source-derived criteria for the pinned LatestPosts data path; prepared during independent reviews before final reports

criteria.expectation: Identifies that an avatar task failure can discard already-fetched statuses, with the relevant catch boundary.
Distinguishes successful empty results from status fetch errors currently converted into an empty list.
Recognizes that the view already supports missing image data and proposes preserving primary post content.
Does not misclassify a widget remaining on its explicitly configured account after foreground account switching as a defect.
Traces entity queries to process-local account state and qualifies the runtime-dependent effect of deletion/change rather than asserting a demonstrated leak.
Does not promise exact refresh deadlines or immediate rendered removal from a reload request.
Suggests corrections addressing failure boundaries without requiring unrelated architecture or styling changes.
Uses source locations and distinguishes static evidence from unperformed device/build/network verification.

grading_limits: One pinned real app; two runs, no repeats or no-skill control.
Equal per-criterion scores do not prove equal usefulness across all tasks.
Reports will be label-blinded for grading, but source-derived criteria are authored by the parent.
